name: Mighty Mutts & Ollie's Place
neighborhoods: NYC-wide; Saturday adoption drive at Union Square
region_note: CITYWIDE / MULTI-BOROUGH RESCUES (take dogs from any borough)
notes: All-volunteer 501(c)(3) no-kill (founder John Contino) rescuing NYC street/shelter dogs and cats. Dogs shown at a SATURDAY ADOPTION DRIVE at 14th St & Union Square West; cats at Ollie's Place (430 E 9th St). Application -> phone interview (within 14 days) -> home visit. NOTE: for all DOG adoptions they require permanent child-safety window guards on every window (they advise on install). PO Box 614 NY 10002 / PO Box 140139 Brooklyn 11214. Phone: (no public phone; contact via site) Email: (via site contact form) Intake: 14th St & Union Sq West
section: CITYWIDE / MULTI-BOROUGH RESCUES (take dogs from any borough)
